title: GA4GH IO Profile Meta-Schema
description: A JSON Schema meta-schema defining the GA4GH standard profile for workflow and tool inputs and outputs across WES and TES.

inputs.description: Definition of the inputs required by the workflow or tool.

outputs.description: Definition of the outputs produced by the workflow or tool.

x-ga4gh-drs-uri.description: Indicates if a string field is expected to be a valid DRS URI.

x-ga4gh-ontology.description: An ontology URI (e.g., EDAM format) explicitly defining the semantic type of the file.

x-ga4gh-ui-widget.description: A hint for UI clients on how to render this input or output.

x-ga4gh-tabular-schema.description: An inline JSON schema validating the rows and columns of a sample sheet or tabular file.

x-ga4gh-fa-icon.description: A FontAwesome icon class to render next to the input field in the UI (e.g., 'fas fa-file-csv').

x-ga4gh-description-format.description: The text format of the 'description' field, allowing smart clients to render rich text.

x-ga4gh-hidden.description: A flag to tell the UI and CLI help to hide advanced or system-level parameters from the default view.

x-ga4gh-error-message.description: A custom, human-readable error message to display if validation fails.
